message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈ 0.1 atm) the melting/freezing point of pure water drops to roughly **–2 °C**.  
In fact, the ice–water equilibrium line on the phase diagram shows a freezing point of about **–2.2 °C** at 10 kPa. This is the temperature at which ice and liquid water coexist in equilibrium under that pressure.
